title: A/R: a reversed deposit is not listed from its reversal date
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X had an unused free deposit of $20.00 that was reversed on day R (a past day).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Collection" in the left list.
  3. Set the date chip to the day before R.
  4. Open customer X's group.
  5. Look for the deposit.
  6. Set the date chip to day R.
  7. Look for customer X or the deposit.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • the deposit is listed at $-20.00.

Step 7:

  • the deposit is not listed.

Why this matters: A reversed deposit is no longer a credit the collector can use.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountReceivable/Service/DbalAccountReceivableCustomerFetcher.php:190. V1 code, quoted: `->andWhere('(d.reversed_at IS NULL OR d.reversed_at > :asOfDate)')`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-026) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
